description: RiverSMART—RiverWare Study Manager And Research Tool is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Colorado Boulder | Center for Advanced Decision Support for Water and Environmental Systems; U.S. Bureau of Reclamation | WaterSMART Program; U.S. Bureau of Reclamation | Upper Colorado Region. This integrated set of tools and techniques supports large studies built upon the RiverWare modeling software. The software framework facilitates the creation, execution, and archiving of RiverWare planning studies. Researchers can set up scenarios representing various hydrologic ensembles, demands, and strategies, such as operating policies and infrastructure alternatives. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Water Infrastructure – General. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
